subject: Evaluation exchange: agenda & data stewardship
messages:
From: Emma Li <emma@craftlane.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exchange: prompt pack + tests (intro & constraints)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As discussed, CraftLane is ready to share a controlled sample of our prompt pack and a hit-list of test cases so your eval team can validate inference behavior and cost/latency expectations on Redwood Dedicated.

Attached: craftlane_promptpack_v2.zip (prompt examples + metadata), testcases_summary.xlsx (50 prioritized cases)

A few constraints from our side that need to be explicit in the MAP:
- Use is limited to evaluation for procurement and integration purposes only; no model training or redistribution.
- Data must be deleted or returned 90 days after delivery unless a formal extension is approved.
- Results and benchmark artifacts can be shared with CraftLane but must not include verbatim prompt packs.

Proposed next steps:
1) Alex/Marissa — review attached and confirm ingestion checklist.
2) Redwood to propose a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (delivery, sandbox ingest, evaluation window, close).
3) Sign the MAP and NDA addendum; we'll provide a DocuSign link.

Can you confirm a target close date for procurement? We're aiming for end of month (Jul 31) if Redwood can meet the timeline.

Best,
Emma Li
Head of AI Partnerships
CraftLane, Inc.
[attachment: craftlane_promptpack_v2.zip (zip)]
[attachment: testcases_summary.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@craftlane.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt pack + tests (intro & constraints)

Emma —

Appreciate the pack and the clarity on constraints. Quick read-through notes and proposed plan below. We'll treat this as a MAP draft that captures milestones, roles, and data stewardship obligations.

High-level agenda for the exchange kickoff call (proposed):
- 15m: Introductions + goals for the evaluation (what success looks like)
- 20m: Inventory of assets (what CraftLane sends + formats)
- 25m: Ingestion and sandbox setup (Redwood tech leads)
- 15m: Security, retention, and usage guardrails (legal & security)
- 15m: Timeline & signoffs / next steps

Suggested stewarding: Vanessa Ortiz to own sandbox access and ingestion schedule; Marissa Cole to coordinate MAP milestones and acceptance criteria; Karthik will lead the runtime/compatibility checks and share quantization/formatting notes.

Key contractual points we will include in the MAP (to match your constraints):
- Purpose-limited license: evaluation only; no derivative training.
- Access window: 45-day evaluation window by default after ingestion.
- Retention: automated purge after 90 days; extension via written approval.
- Output-sharing: aggregate metrics and example non-sensitive excerpts allowed; no release of raw prompt pack content.

I attached a Redwood template MAP and suggested milestone dates so we can align quickly. If Jul 31 close is the target, we need: ingestion by Jul 19, 45-day window begins Jul 20, and final procurement signoff by Jul 31.

Attachments: redwood_MAP_template.docx (MAP template)

I'll set up a 45-min kickoff for tomorrow afternoon (Fri) — does 2pm PT work for your team?

—Alex
Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_MAP_template.docx (docx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>, Emma Li <emma@craftlane.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt pack + tests (intro & constraints)

Emma / Alex —

Couple of technical guardrails from the runtime side to flag before ingestion:
- Format: we require JSONL with explicit metadata fields (prompt_id, example_inputs, metadata.lossy=false) or a packaged CSV + manifest. We'll convert the zip but want to avoid manual remapping.
- PII: please flag any prompts that include user PII; those will need tokenization / redaction and a different handling SLA.
- Model variants: for latency benchmarking we'll run the same testcases across two model families; any model-specific constraints (e.g., max sequence length) should be noted in metadata.
- Sandbox environment: Vanessa — we'll need a dedicated sandbox project with restricted egress (no external network) and tokenized logs retained only for debugging for 30 days.

Operational asks:
1) CraftLane to provide a manifest mapping testcases to intents and expected behavior (link to testcases_summary.xlsx is fine).
2) Confirm if any prompts are under legal embargo or require additional controls.
3) Share a contact for procurement to expedite DocuSign once MAP is finalized.

If these are OK we can proceed on the proposed timeline. Minor formatting changes from your zip will be handled by our ingestion tooling; we try to avoid re-encoding text to preserve fidelity.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Inference Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Emma Li <emma@craftlane.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exchange: prompt pack + tests (intro & constraints)

Thanks — all sounds good and we appreciate the level of detail. Confirming:
- We'll export the prompt pack as JSONL with the manifest and flag any PII rows.
- No legal embargo on the supplied 50 testcases; full rights for evaluation only.
- Procurement contact: Daniel Park (daniel.park@craftlane.com) — he'll review the MAP and DocuSign flow.

Requested adjustments to the draft MAP (quick items):
- Add a clause for limited-staff access on the CraftLane side (list to be provided).
- Add a clause requiring Redwood to provide redacted sample outputs before full results sharing.

I have routed the DocuSign request; link below (live for 7 days):
https://www.docusign.com/CL-8821-MAP

Proposed close timeline updated: ingestion target Jul 19 (we are running pre-checks), evaluation window Jul 20 - Aug 3, procurement signoff by Jul 31. If Redwood can complete the acceptance checklist by Aug 3 we'll mark the project closed.

Emma Li
Head of AI Partnerships
CraftLane, Inc.
